user_query: I'm planning a road trip across Europe and I want to know the details of each country. Fetch the country details by FIFA code for all the countries in Europe. Also, provide me with the list of supported makes and types of cars for my journey.

TaskList.description: Fetch the list of European countries and their FIFA codes.
Query country details using the FIFA codes retrieved from step 1.
Retrieve a list of supported makes and types of cars for the road trip.
